- Next [...] ## Bifura Description [...] AI assistants and agents navigate websites to gather, compare, and suggest information for potential buyers. Bifura examines how AI crawlers interact with a webpage that lacks JavaScript, showcasing the retrieved content, structured data, and the interpretations made by AI models alongside the user-facing interface. It generates an Agent readiness score ranging from 0 to 100, categorizes findings as either code-derived or model-evaluated, and formulates a strategic plan featuring milestones at 30, 60, and 90 days. Users can pose questions that a buyer might ask an AI assistant and can follow the origins of each response.
